name: Herdr Dot
author: Andrew Dunne
description: A dot in the bar counting the herdr agents waiting for you, across every herdr session on this computer and on your SSH hosts; click it for the list and jump to one

barWidget.description: Number of herdr agents waiting for you; click for the list, grouped by session

schema.label: Remote hosts
schema.description: SSH targets whose herdr sessions are watched too, separated by spaces or commas, e.g. me@server. SSH must work without a password prompt.
